faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about CV Booster

whatDoIGet.question: What do I get with CV Booster?
whatDoIGet.answer: You get a comprehensive analysis including ATS-optimised bullet point rewrites, stronger action verb suggestions, keyword recommendations for your industry, and red flags that recruiters might notice. Everything is written in direct, actionable language.

howLong.question: How long does the analysis take?
howLong.answer: Your CV analysis is generated instantly after payment. You will see your results on the success page within seconds.

fileFormats.question: What file formats do you accept?
fileFormats.answer: We accept PDF files, Word documents (DOCX), and plain text. Simply upload your CV file or paste your CV text directly into the input field.

subscription.question: Is this a subscription?
subscription.answer: No. CV Booster is a one-time payment of £20. There are no subscriptions, recurring charges, or upsells.

share.question: Can I share my analysis with others?
share.answer: Yes! After your analysis is complete, you can copy a shareable link to send to mentors, career coaches, or anyone you want feedback from.

whoWrites.question: Who writes the feedback?
whoWrites.answer: The feedback is generated by AI trained to think like a recruiter. It focuses on what actually matters in the hiring process, not generic career advice.

dataStorage.question: Do you store my CV data?
dataStorage.answer: No. We do not store or collect your CV content. Your CV is processed in real-time to generate your analysis, and then immediately discarded. We never retain your personal information.

vsChatGPT.question: Why is this better than ChatGPT or CV templates?
vsChatGPT.answer: CV Booster is purpose-built for ATS optimisation with a 5-category weighted scoring system, 14 industry-specific templates, and recruiter-calibrated feedback. Unlike ChatGPT, you get consistent 10-section structured output without prompt engineering. Unlike templates, we provide personalised rewrites, LinkedIn analysis, and job description alignment. Your data is immediately discarded—never used for training.
